eval.description: Anthropic internal cyber eval that runs agents against targets drawn from the public OSS-Fuzz corpus (on the order of thousands of entry points across about a thousand projects). Cards report graded scores from no hit through higher-severity crash tiers and rates of non-zero or top scores. Dataset and runner are lab-internal.
eval.summary: Measures how well AI agents find software bugs that cause crashes in real open-source programs.

links.title: Mythos Preview cyber safety report (OSS-Fuzz severity ladder)

versions.changes: Anthropic reports OSS-Fuzz agent scores across system cards; exact task bank and thresholds are not published.

scores.description: Per-target graded score from Anthropic's harness (cards use thresholds such as above 0, at least 0.4, and 1.0).

metrics.description: Share of targets with score above 0 (also reported as vulnerability identification rate or inverse zero-score rate).
